info.title: PlayGuard
info.author: JigSawFr
info.details:
PlayGuard sets the Nintendo Switch's built-in parental controls directly on the console, offline, without the phone app or a Nintendo account. It does not replace them: the countdown, the PIN prompt and the suspension at the limit are the console's own, nothing runs in the background, and the limits stay if PlayGuard is removed.

Daily play-time limit, the same every day or per weekday, with profiles, extra time or no more play today, and a bedtime alarm. Play activity per game and per user account, exported to CSV, JSON, XLSX or PDF. Restriction level, age rating, PIN and a one-switch console lock. Network clock set from NTP servers so the timer stays accurate offline. Unlinks the companion app on second-hand consoles; an optional recovery sysmodule (separate download) handles a forgotten PIN. Change history with undo, backups, every console language.

Requires Atmosphère. Supports firmware 21.0.0 to 22.5.0; a newer firmware opens read-only until a release supports it.

changelog:
First release: the settings of Nintendo's Parental Controls phone app, on the console itself, offline. Custom firmware (Atmosphère) required.

- Play-time limit: the same every day or one per day on a week chart, saved profiles, extra time today in one press, and a one-switch console lock.
- Activity: play time per game and per user account, day by day, a summary per period, and export to CSV, JSON, XLSX or PDF.
- Restrictions and PIN: restriction level, age rating and its organisation, show or change the PIN, and an optional PIN to open PlayGuard.
- Network clock: set from public NTP servers, so the play timer counts right on a console that never reaches Nintendo.
- Safe by design: the play timer is never written while it counts down, every change is logged and can be undone, settings are backed up to the SD card.
- A way back in: a recovery sysmodule for a forgotten PIN, and unlinking the phone app on a second-hand console.
- Updates and reports: update in place from PlayGuard, "What's new" after each update, diagnostic reports sent as a link and QR codes.
- Languages and themes: every console language, light and dark themes.

Full notes: https://github.com/JigSawFr/PlayGuard/releases/tag/v1.0.0
